_comment: The official Atwe company account for beta. Copy to seed/atwe-beta.json and edit.
PUBLIC PROFILE TEXT ONLY. There is deliberately no password field, and the tool
REFUSES a file carrying password / passwordHash / secret / token / stripe / oauth /
totp / session / isAdmin or any other credential or permission. The password comes
from BETA_SEED_PASSWORD or a hidden prompt; the role is set here and shown back to
you for confirmation before anything is written.
accountType: the app has exactly two, personal and business. A company IS a business
account -- Atwe has no separate company page.
role: "member" is an ordinary account with no staff access, which is what tests the
real product. "admin" gives the staff dashboard and should be asked for deliberately.
NOTE: "atwe" is a RESERVED username (routes.js SYSTEM_ROUTES). The tool refuses it
unless you pass --claim-reserved, and leaves the reservation in place afterwards so
the name stays locked against everyone else.
